Hey welcome to The Pittsburgh Chiropractor formerly Tauberg Chiropractic & Richland Chiropractic.  Thank you for visiting my page! I'm a Primary Spine Practitioner and evidence based chiropractor in Pittsburgh PA. My goal with this channel is to educate the public and hopefully to be entertaining. My goal in practice is to get people out of pain and back to enjoying their favorite activities, hopefully my channel can do that too. 

My practice is The Pittsburgh Chiropractor if your in the  Pittsburgh, PA area or are going to be Id love to meet you.  Please feel free to check out my website to learn more about my practice and myself. www.ThePittsburghChiropractor.com
